newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Kirishi oil refinery boosts Q1 1997 output.
newsitem.headline: Russia Kirishi oil refinery boosts Q1 1997 output.

text.p: Russia's OAO Kirishinefteorgsintez oil refinery processed 3.86 million tonnes of crude oil in the first quarter of 1997, 11 percent higher than the year-ago period, a plant spokeswoman said on Tuesday.

Kirishinefteorgsintez, also know as Kirishi, is owned by NK Surgutneftegaz (Surgut Holding), one of Russia's top oil companies, and is strategically located outside St Petersburg in northwestern Russia. Its total capacity is around 20 million tonnes a year.
The refinery is among Russia's top exporters of heavy fuel oil to European markets.
Total oil throughput rose in 1996 to 15.3 million tonnes from 12.1 million tonnes in 1995.
